notes.title: Spring is a time of change when nature awakens and comes to life.
notes.content:
On March 22 (March 9 in the old calendar), Eastern and Southern Slavs have long celebrated Soroki—the day when, according to tradition, forty skylarks arrive, bringing warmth and awakening nature. People used to bake bird-shaped buns to welcome spring and leave the cold behind.

We decided to celebrate this holiday as well and added something special to the game that symbolizes Soroki. Can you find it?

Also, the Steam Spring Sale starts today, making it the perfect time to check out our game or return to it!

Thanks to your feedback, we have been actively working on improving the game and fixed many issues.

The biggest update in this patch: we’ve finally fixed the save system! Now, you no longer have to worry about bugs that occurred when loading days.

It’s been a tough month. Thank you for playing, sharing your feedback, and helping us make the game better!

notes.title: Hola, chic@s!
notes.content:
Hola, chic@s! We've updated the Spanish localization in our game. The translation isn't professional, but it's now more carefully edited and feels much better!
 Thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: Big Update
First Update
notes.content:
The first 24 hours since the game's launch have passed, and we're very excited, closely monitoring the feedback.

We've noticed that some players experienced sound issues at the ending. We worked to resolve this as quickly as possible.

We hope the new update will fix these issues.

Thank you for playing our game and for your feedback!

notes.title: Streamers play our demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've updated the game demo once again. The work is bustling! Thanks to everyone who plays Unforgotten and follows us.

What's new?

- Localization in Spanish, Italian, German, French, Japanese, Chinese
- Characters now have facial expressions
- Added the main character's hands
- A second ending that depends on the player's actions
- New atmospheric sounds and ambient tracks
- Reputation and relationships with characters
- Burning cobwebs!

A few words about localization: We made a tough, but we believe important decision to add as many languages as possible for a comfortable gameplay experience. Unfortunately, we didn't have time to look for professional translators, so the translations were done using DeepL. If you would like to help with the texts, please write to us! We would appreciate any help.

Thanks everyone and have a great day!

notes.title: Gameplay horror Unforgotten
notes.content: Hey, its good time to play our demo!

notes.title: Update demo
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

We are eternally grateful to everyone who played our demo version and especially to those who made a video review of it. 

All the videos have been watched and a huge pile of useful feedback has been collected. 

Now we are preparing for the summer festival of demos and will be actively refining the game. And we have already managed to make some improvements:
- The game is now  playable on Steamdeck.
- The lighter heating mechanic has appeared.
- A lot of text bugs have been fixed.
- Optimization has been improved.
- Improved soundtrack of the game.
